blocks.h2: When to Call About a Faucet
blocks.intro: Most faucet problems are one of these:

tiles.body: A worn cartridge, washer or O-ring. On a good faucet, it's a simple fix.
Loose supply lines, a tired shutoff valve or a drain connection that's slipped.
A blocked aerator, a failing cartridge or, in older homes, the pipe behind the wall.
The mounting has loosened, and water can get under the faucet base.

bodies: We fix dripping and leaking kitchen faucets and install new ones, from simple single-handle models to pull-down sprayers, touchless faucets and filtered-water taps.

In older Elgin homes, the sink and the shutoff valves under it may be original. Old valves can refuse to close or start leaking once they're turned. We replace them as part of the install when needed, so the new faucet has a solid start.

We handle the rest of the kitchen too: sink drains, dishwasher hookups, ice maker and refrigerator lines, disposals and gas connections for ranges. For a remodel, we reroute or add plumbing to match the new layout.

Clogged sink? See [drain cleaning](/elgin/drain-cleaning). Disposal not working? See [garbage disposal repair](/elgin/garbage-disposal-installation-repair). New gas range? See [gas line installation](/elgin/gas-line-installation).

img.alt: Plumbing under a double kitchen sink: white PVC drain and P-trap, braided supply lines with chrome shutoff valves, and a garbage disposal

bodies: We install sinks, faucets, toilets, showerheads, tub fillers, laundry sinks and outdoor spigots, from a single swap to every fixture in a new bathroom. Each install includes connections, new shutoffs where needed and a leak check.

Bought your fixtures already? Send us the make and model so we can confirm the fit. For toilets, see [toilet installation](/elgin/toilet-installation-repair). For showers, see [shower repair](/elgin/shower-repair).

blocks.h2: Faucets and Fixtures in Elgin Homes
blocks.intro: From 1800s homes near downtown to 2000s homes on the west side, fixture work in Elgin varies a lot.

items.body: Historic bathrooms often have pedestal or wall-mount sinks with spacing that modern faucets don't match. We'll help you find one that fits instead of forcing it.
If a brand-new faucet still has weak flow, old galvanized supply pipe may be the cause. We'll tell you if we see it.
Homes from the 1990s and 2000s often still have their original faucets. Upgrading several at once saves trips.

blocks.h2: Faucet and Fixture Questions From Elgin Homeowners

items.q: Can you install a faucet I already bought?
items.preview: Yes. Send us the make and model first.
items.answer: Yes. Tell us the make and model and we'll confirm it fits your sink and plumbing before the visit.

items.q: Why does my faucet drip even when it's off?
items.preview: A worn cartridge or seal inside.
items.answer: A worn cartridge, washer or seal inside the faucet lets water through. Replacing that part usually fixes it.

items.q: Can you replace a faucet on an old pedestal sink?
items.preview: Usually. We'll find one that fits the hole spacing.
items.answer: Usually. Older sinks often have unusual hole spacing. We'll help you choose a faucet that fits properly.

items.q: Should I fix or replace my faucet?
items.preview: Fix a good faucet with a worn part. Replace a corroded one.
items.answer: If it's a quality faucet with a worn part, fix it. If the body is corroded or parts are no longer made, replacing it is the better value.

items.q: How much does faucet installation cost in Elgin?
items.preview: It depends on the faucet and what's under the sink. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the faucet, the valves and supply lines and access. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
